# awesome-free-ai-coding

> Legal free LLM APIs and coding agents for AI coding — free tiers, no-card trials and free models, probe-verified twice a week against live model catalogs and pricing pages. Generated 2026-09-11 from the registry; every offer under the first four headings answered its last probe.

Each offer links to a page with the free tier in the vendor's own words, the connection details (base URL, where to get a key, model ids, an Anthropic-format URL where the vendor documents one), the evidence the probe reads and the row's history. "No card" means the vendor asks for no payment method; "no key" means the endpoint answers without an account. Offers that stopped answering their probe are listed last, under Archived.

## Coding agents & CLIs

- [opencode](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/opencode/): Open-source TUI/desktop coding agent with six zero-priced models included via the opencode Zen gateway (Big Pickle, MiMo-V2.5, Ling 3.0 Flash Fin, Nemotron 3 Ultra, Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, Muse Spark 1.2 Contributor); any provider via BYOK too; no card; key from https://opencode.ai/auth; OpenAI-compatible at https://opencode.ai/zen/v1; free models: `big-pickle`, `mimo-v2.5`, `ling-3.0-flash-fin`, `nemotron-3-ultra`, `nemotron-3.5-lightning`, `muse-spark-1.2`
- [Kilo Code](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/kilo-code/): Open-source VS Code / JetBrains / CLI agent; its $0 plan routes "Auto Free" to the zero-priced models the Kilo Gateway carries, and the same gateway answers any OpenAI client directly, with BYOK and local models (Ollama, LM Studio) alongside; no card; key from https://app.kilo.ai/profile; OpenAI-compatible at https://api.kilo.ai/api/gateway; free models: `nemotron-3-ultra`, `nemotron-3-super`, `north-mini-code`, `step-3.7-flash`, `laguna-s-2.1`, `laguna-xs-2.1`
- [Google Antigravity](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/antigravity/): Google's agent-first IDE and CLI, and where the Gemini CLI free tier went — Gemini CLI and the Code Assist IDE extensions stopped serving free, AI Pro and Ultra users on 2026-06-18. The $0 Individual plan carries the same agent models the paid ones do; no card; free models: `gemini-3.1-pro`, `gemini-3.8-flash`, `gemini-3.7-flash`, `gemini-3.6-flash`, `claude-opus-4.6`, `claude-sonnet-4.6`, `gpt-oss`
- [Freebuff](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/freebuff/): Ad-funded coding agent in five surfaces — CLI, desktop, browser app builder, cloud sandbox on any GitHub repo, and chat — with no account, no API key and no card; GLM 5.3 Flash by default, with GPT-5.6 Luna, DeepSeek V4 Flash and MiMo 2.5 in the picker; no card; free models: `glm-5.3-flash`, `gpt-5.6-luna`, `deepseek-v4-flash`, `mimo-v2.5`; provisional since 2026-09-02
- [OpenAI Codex CLI](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/openai-codex-cli/): Open-source coding CLI, free by signing in with a $0 ChatGPT Free account; local coding tasks included on all plans; no card; free models: `gpt-5.6`
- [Crush + Charm Hyper](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/charm-hyper/): Charm's Crush terminal agent with Hyper, its official hosted model gateway; the free plan includes monthly Hypercredits, zero data retention; no card
- [CodeGPT](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/codegpt/): VS Code / JetBrains coding agent whose $0 plan includes model usage rather than only BYOK — a small daily allowance on its own Economy models, plus BYOK across 15+ providers and local models (Ollama, LM Studio) beside it; no card

- [Z.ai (Zhipu GLM)](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/zai-glm/): GLM Flash models free on the API, vision included (OpenAI-compatible at api.z.ai/api/paas/v4); no card; key from https://z.ai/manage-apikey/apikey-list; OpenAI-compatible at https://api.z.ai/api/paas/v4; Anthropic Messages at https://api.z.ai/api/anthropic; free models: `glm-4.7-flash`, `glm-4.5-flash`, `glm-4.6v-flash`
- [Cloudflare Workers AI](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/cloudflare-workers-ai/): 10k neurons/day free; no card; key from https://dash.cloudflare.com/profile/api-tokens; OpenAI-compatible at https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/ai/v1; free models: `llama-4`
- [SambaNova Cloud](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/sambanova-cloud/): Open models on SambaNova's RDU hardware, OpenAI-compatible; the free tier is the one that applies while no payment method is linked, so linking a card is what ends it; no card; key from https://cloud.sambanova.ai/apis; OpenAI-compatible at https://api.sambanova.ai/v1; free models: `deepseek`, `gpt-oss`, `gemma-4`
- [Hetzner Inference API](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/hetzner-inference/): OpenAI-compatible API on Hetzner's own EU hardware, free for as long as the experiment runs; no card; key from https://experiments.hetzner.com/inference; OpenAI-compatible at https://inference.hetzner.com/api/v1; free models: `qwen3.6`, `qwen3.8`
- [Alibaba Cloud Model Studio (DashScope, international)](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/alibaba-model-studio/): Free quota for Qwen models on DashScope, international (Singapore) region; OpenAI-compatible; no card; key from https://modelstudio.console.alibabacloud.com; OpenAI-compatible at https://dashscope-intl.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1; free models: `qwen3.8-max`, `qwen3-max`, `qwen3-coder`
- [NVIDIA NIM (build.nvidia.com)](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/nvidia-nim/): Free hosted NIM endpoints for 100+ models via the free NVIDIA Developer Program (OpenAI-compatible at integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1); no card; key from https://build.nvidia.com; OpenAI-compatible at https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1; free models: `nemotron`
- [Cohere (trial keys)](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/cohere/): Cohere Command models via free trial API keys that never expire, plus North Mini Code — a 30B/3B Apache-2.0 coding model Cohere prices at zero on every key type; no card; key from https://dashboard.cohere.com/api-keys; OpenAI-compatible at https://api.cohere.com/compatibility/v1; free models: `command-a`, `north-mini-code`
- [OVHcloud AI Endpoints](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/ovh-ai-endpoints/): EU-hosted serverless open-model API — 24 models, and the anonymous lane needs no signup, no key and no card (OpenAI-compatible); no card; no key; OpenAI-compatible at https://oai.endpoints.kepler.ai.cloud.ovh.net/v1; free models: `gpt-oss`, `qwen3.6`, `qwen3.8`, `qwen3-coder`
- [SEA-LION (AI Singapore)](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/sea-lion/): AI Singapore's open Southeast-Asian model family behind a first-party OpenAI-compatible API — the vendor hosting its own weights rather than a gateway reselling somebody else's; no card; key from https://playground.sea-lion.ai/key-manager; OpenAI-compatible at https://api.sea-lion.ai/v1
- [OpenTyphoon (SCB 10X)](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/opentyphoon/): Thai-tuned open models from SCB 10X, the venture arm of Siam Commercial Bank, behind an OpenAI-compatible API whose FAQ calls it a research showcase and free to use; no card; key from https://playground.opentyphoon.ai/api-key; OpenAI-compatible at https://api.opentyphoon.ai/v1; provisional since 2026-09-05
- [SenseNova (SenseTime 商汤)](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/sensenova/): SenseTime's own SenseNova models behind an OpenAI-compatible url, free for everyone while the token plan is in public beta; no card; key from https://platform.sensenova.cn; OpenAI-compatible at https://token.sensenova.cn/v1
- [Pollinations.AI](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/pollinations/): Open GenAI text API, no signup, OpenAI-compatible (POST text.pollinations.ai/openai); no card; no key; OpenAI-compatible at https://text.pollinations.ai/openai; free models: `gpt-oss`
- [FreeInference (Harvard SEAS)](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/freeinference/): Harvard SEAS's MadSys Lab serving frontier open models — DeepSeek V4 Flash, GLM-5.1, GLM 5.3 Flash, MiniMax M3, Qwen3.6 35B — free to every account behind both an OpenAI-shaped and an Anthropic-shaped endpoint, with a documented Claude Code setup; no card; key from https://freeinference.org; OpenAI-compatible at https://freeinference.org/v1; Anthropic Messages at https://freeinference.org/anthropic; free models: `deepseek-v4-flash`, `glm-5.1`, `glm-5.3-flash`, `minimax-m3`, `qwen3.6`; provisional since 2026-09-05
- [Ollama Cloud](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/ollama-cloud/): Cloud-hosted open models on a $0 plan that grants starter usage credits for a starter subset of the catalog; no card; key from https://ollama.com/settings/keys; OpenAI-compatible at https://ollama.com/v1
- [Mistral La Plateforme](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/mistral-free/): Free mode on La Plateforme — API keys plus an included monthly usage allowance; no card; key from https://console.mistral.ai/api-keys; OpenAI-compatible at https://api.mistral.ai/v1
- [Poolside Platform](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/poolside/): Free self-serve developer access to the Laguna coding models, direct from the vendor whose models this list already carries second-hand through OpenRouter and Kilo Gateway; no card; key from https://platform.poolside.ai; OpenAI-compatible at https://inference.poolside.ai/v1
- [uncloseai (unturf)](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/uncloseai/): Keyless OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint — no signup, no key, no account; no card; no key; OpenAI-compatible at https://hermes.ai.unturf.com/v1
- [IBM watsonx.ai (Lite plan)](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/ibm-watsonx-ai/): IBM's watsonx.ai Runtime on its Lite plan — 300,000 tokens a month of foundation-model inference (Granite, Llama, Mistral and other hosted models) on IBM Cloud, a plan IBM's own docs call free and never bill; card required; key from https://cloud.ibm.com/iam/apikeys; API at https://us-south.ml.cloud.ibm.com/ml/v1; provisional since 2026-09-05
- [Scaleway Generative APIs](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/scaleway-generative/): EU-made serverless LLM API (OpenAI-compatible); 1M free tokens for every new customer; card required; key from https://console.scaleway.com; OpenAI-compatible at https://api.scaleway.ai/v1

## Trials (no card when possible)

- [GitHub Copilot Free](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/github-copilot-free/): Free Copilot plan for individual developers in VS Code, JetBrains, Visual Studio and CLI; completions, limited chat and agent usage; no card
- [Kiro](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/kiro/): Perpetual free tier of AWS's spec-driven agentic IDE (successor to Amazon Q Developer) with Claude Sonnet 4.5 and open-weight models; no card; free models: `claude-sonnet-4.5`, `qwen3-coder`, `deepseek-v3.2`, `minimax-2.1`
- [Google Jules](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/google-jules/): Free tier of Google's async cloud coding agent powered by Gemini 2.5 Pro; connects to GitHub repos and works autonomously; no card; free models: `gemini-2.5`
- [Cerebras Inference](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/cerebras-free/): Very fast inference; $5 in trial credits that expire in 30 days, card required before the API answers at all; card required; key from https://cloud.cerebras.ai; OpenAI-compatible at https://api.cerebras.ai/v1; free models: `gpt-oss`, `qwen3.8`
- [Cursor (Hobby)](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/cursor-hobby/): Permanent free Hobby plan of the Cursor AI IDE with limited Agent requests and Tab completions, no credit card; no card
- [Devin Desktop (formerly Windsurf)](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/windsurf/): Free plan of Cognition's desktop coding agent — the IDE that shipped as Windsurf; no card
- [Qoder](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/qoder/): Alibaba's agentic coding IDE + CLI; Pro trial with credits on signup, then a free plan with basic models; no card
- [CodeBuddy (Tencent)](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/codebuddy/): Tencent's VS Code / JetBrains / CLI coding agent whose Free plan carries 100 credits a month, a daily activity bonus of 30 and 250 welcome credits, with every model open while the promotion runs; no card; provisional since 2026-09-02
- [Trae](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/trae/): Free access to frontier models in IDE; no card
- [Regolo AI](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/regolo/): EU (Italian) zero-retention inference; a month of full model access on a daily token allowance, no card; no card; key from https://dashboard.regolo.ai; OpenAI-compatible at https://api.regolo.ai/v1; free models: `glm-5`, `gpt-oss`, `qwen3.8`, `llama-3.3`, `apertus-70b`
- [Upstage (Solar API)](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/upstage/): Upstage Solar LLM API; $10 free credit on signup, no card; no card; key from https://console.upstage.ai/api-keys; OpenAI-compatible at https://api.upstage.ai/v1; free models: `solar-pro-3`, `solar-mini`
- [Infomaniak AI Services](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/infomaniak-ai/): Swiss sovereign-cloud API over open-weight models with a one-month trial wallet of one million credits, one credit per LLM token; card required; key from https://manager.infomaniak.com; OpenAI-compatible at https://api.infomaniak.com/2/ai/{product_id}/openai/v1; provisional since 2026-09-02
- [Qodo](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/qodo/): Agentic PR code review plus Git and IDE integrations on a 14-day Pro Team trial with unlimited reviews and credits and no card; no card; provisional since 2026-09-02
- [Sarvam AI](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/sarvam/): India's Sarvam AI credits every new account ₹100 to spend on any of its APIs — its own Sarvam-105B chat model beside hosted DeepSeek V4 Flash, GLM 5.3 Flash and Gemma 4 — through an OpenAI-shaped chat endpoint; no card; key from https://dashboard.sarvam.ai; OpenAI-compatible at https://api.sarvam.ai/v1; free models: `sarvam-105b`, `deepseek-v4-flash`, `glm-5.3-flash`; provisional since 2026-09-05
- [Inception Labs (Mercury)](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/inception-labs/): A signup grant on the Mercury diffusion models — Mercury 2.5 and Mercury 2 for chat, Mercury Edit 2 for fill-in-the-middle and code edits; the last is the reason this row is here, since an FIM endpoint is what an IDE completion plugin actually calls; no card; key from https://platform.inceptionlabs.ai; OpenAI-compatible at https://api.inceptionlabs.ai/v1; free models: `mercury-2.5`, `mercury-2`, `mercury-edit-2`
- [RouterPlex](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/routerplex/): A one-time $1 of test credit on a prepaid reseller that bills 54 chat models at vendor list prices with 0% markup, no card — one key on both wires, OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions and an Anthropic Messages base Claude Code takes as it is; no card; key from https://routerplex.com/sign-up; OpenAI-compatible at https://api.routerplex.com/v1; Anthropic Messages at https://api.routerplex.com; provisional since 2026-09-11
- [Standard Compute](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/standardcompute/): A one-time $0.25 of smart-routed compute on a flat-rate agent gateway, no card — a real key on both wires, OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions and an Anthropic Messages base Claude Code takes as it is; no card; key from https://standardcompute.com/signup; OpenAI-compatible at https://api.stdcmpt.com/v1; Anthropic Messages at https://api.stdcmpt.com; provisional since 2026-09-07

## Aggregators (one key, many providers)

- [OpenRouter (free models)](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/openrouter-free/): One API key for rotating :free variants of frontier models; no card; key from https://openrouter.ai/settings/keys; OpenAI-compatible at https://openrouter.ai/api/v1; Anthropic Messages at https://openrouter.ai/api; free models: `nemotron-3-ultra`, `gemma-4`
- [Requesty](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/requesty/): OpenAI-compatible router over a 690+ model catalog with routing, caching and fallbacks; twelve rows in it are priced 0 and the free plan is the same gateway restricted to those; no card; key from https://app.requesty.ai/api-keys; OpenAI-compatible at https://router.requesty.ai/v1; Anthropic Messages at https://router.requesty.ai; free models: `nemotron-3-ultra`, `nemotron-3-super`, `gemma-4`, `ling-3.0-tiny`
- [AIHubMix (free models)](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/aihubmix/): One OpenAI-compatible gateway over 800+ models, 56 of which the platform prices at 0 and subsidises itself; both /v1/chat/completions and Anthropic-format /v1/messages are served, so a free id can back Claude Code directly; no card; key from https://aihubmix.com/token; OpenAI-compatible at https://aihubmix.com/v1; Anthropic Messages at https://aihubmix.com; free models: `glm-5`, `mimo-v2.5`, `north-mini-code`, `gpt-oss`
- [Routeway](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/routeway/): OpenAI-compatible gateway whose :free lane rotates — four zero-priced ids on 2026-09-05, Meta's Muse Glimmer 30B, DeepSeek V4 Flash, Kimi K2.6 and MiniMax M2.7 — beside 241 metered rows in the same catalog; no card; key from https://routeway.ai/dashboard/keys; OpenAI-compatible at https://api.routeway.ai/v1
- [LLMTR](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/llmtr/): Turkish OpenAI-compatible gateway with a daily-quota free lane that answers on a zero balance — eight zero-priced ids on 2026-09-07, Nemotron 3 Ultra, Qwen3.6 27B and Ling 3.0 Flash among them; no card; key from https://llmtr.com/dashboard/api-keys; OpenAI-compatible at https://llmtr.com/v1; free models: `nemotron-3-ultra`, `qwen3.6`; provisional since 2026-09-02
- [Vercel AI Gateway](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/vercel-ai-gateway/): One OpenAI-compatible endpoint for 360+ models, with $5 of gateway credits included every month and five language models that never touch the credit; no card; key from https://vercel.com/dashboard/ai-gateway/api-keys; OpenAI-compatible at https://ai-gateway.vercel.sh/v1; Anthropic Messages at https://ai-gateway.vercel.sh; free models: `laguna-s-2.1`
- [Kenari](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/kenari/): Indonesian OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible gateway whose :free ids are billed Rp 0 behind a per-minute and a daily cap — thirteen on 2026-09-03, GLM-4.7-Flash, Nemotron 3 Ultra, Hy3 and Mistral Medium 3.5 among them; no card; key from https://kenari.id/keys; OpenAI-compatible at https://kenari.id/v1; Anthropic Messages at https://kenari.id; free models: `nemotron-3-ultra`, `nemotron-3-super`, `step-3.7-flash`, `laguna-s-2.1`; provisional since 2026-09-02
- [BazaarLink](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/bazaarlink/): OpenAI-compatible gateway to a 183-id catalog with exactly two zero-priced rows — Qwen3.7 Flash and the auto:free router; no card; key from https://bazaarlink.ai/keys; OpenAI-compatible at https://api.bazaarlink.ai/v1; free models: `qwen3.7-flash`
- [TokenRouter (PaleBlueDot)](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/tokenrouter/): Two zero-priced ids — Nemotron 3 Nano Omni and GLM 5.3, in the default group — inside a 134-row catalog metered at list rates; no card; key from https://www.tokenrouter.com/console/token; OpenAI-compatible at https://api.tokenrouter.com/v1; free models: `nemotron-3-nano-omni`
- [Hugging Face Inference Providers](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/huggingface-inference/): Routed access to 200+ models across providers (Groq, Cerebras, Together, etc.) with a free HF account; no card; key from https://huggingface.co/settings/tokens; OpenAI-compatible at https://router.huggingface.co/v1
- [MegaNova](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/meganova/): OpenAI-compatible gateway whose no-card Tier 1 account gets a daily free quota on Mistral Small 3.2 and the house Manta routers — 50 a day per model, 550 across the lane; no card; key from https://www.meganova.ai/api-keys; OpenAI-compatible at https://api.meganova.ai/v1; free models: `mistral-small-3.2`; provisional since 2026-09-02

## Machine-readable

- [index.json](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/index.json): every row with its connection details and probe, plus the watchlist of services considered and not listed
- [feed.xml](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/feed.xml): Atom feed of every change — rows arriving, leaving and changing their free models
- [Provider pages](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/): one page per row, live and archived
- [Filterable table](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/browse.html): the same rows filtered by category, card, key and API format
- [configs/opencode.json](https://github.com/mvalentsev/awesome-free-ai-coding/blob/main/configs/opencode.json): opencode config with every OpenAI-compatible row wired up
- [configs/claude-code.sh](https://github.com/mvalentsev/awesome-free-ai-coding/blob/main/configs/claude-code.sh): one shell function per gateway that serves the Anthropic Messages format, for Claude Code
- [configs/litellm.yaml](https://github.com/mvalentsev/awesome-free-ai-coding/blob/main/configs/litellm.yaml): LiteLLM proxy config over the same rows
- [README](https://github.com/mvalentsev/awesome-free-ai-coding): the list itself, with the picks table and how it stays fresh
- [CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/mvalentsev/awesome-free-ai-coding/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): what qualifies, how rows are ranked, how the probes work
